verdict.rationale: Workable's ReadMe-hosted API reference has the "Try It!" request runner and SDK code snippets enabled, so users can browse endpoints and run real requests from the docs. The runner only executes against the caller's live account with a real Bearer token, and no test environment exists, which makes exploration risky. Missing for 10: a sandbox or test base URL/keys/tenant for safe runnable examples, a published or downloadable OpenAPI spec (the download is disabled and all paths return 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the Try It experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
